page.overview:
Who is Cecil Anderson?

Cecil Anderson was a wizard who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

At the age of eleven, Cecil attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and was sorted into an unknown House. He eventually made it to his House Quidditch team as a Beater. At some point, Cecil became known to Willa Weholt, who used to see him practise Quidditch over the Great Lake, as he said it made the landings softer. According to Willa, Cecil was a great Beater who hated to lose, even to his teammates, and that's why he practised alone so often.

Cecil used to be teased about the Quidditch rules by fellow student Flossie Cooper. She was always quoting a rulebook at him, and Willa was sure he tossed a few copies of that book into the lake.

During his time at the school, his Beater's bat, with his name carved into it, ended up at the bottom of the Great Lake. Cecil was a fan of the Appleby Arrows and owned a bow and arrow with the initials C.A. carved into them that also ended up at the bottom of the lake. Apparently he used to follow the tradition of shooting arrows into the air whenever his team scored.
